lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the stale ratchet loosening finding recorded in this story's prd.json notes: scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling was raised 159->165 by US-002 to justify a jsLiteral Unicode-escape special-case, US-R1-003 later reverted that special-case (patterns.md:1028), and the file is back to a gate-measured (content.split('\n').length) actual of 159 lines -- but the ceiling was left at 165, a 7-line loosening with no code behind it and an _ref narrative describing code no longer on the branch. Restored the ceiling to 159 and prepended a dated _ref note (US-R2-002, CAM-433) documenting the restore, in the same commit. Verified: `bun -e "console.log(require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts','utf8').split('\n').length)"` -> 159, matching the restored ceiling exactly (no headroom needed, actual == ceiling). Full gates re-run clean: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5665 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all-green (file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, embed-vendor up to date). No patterns.md bullet added: this is a mechanical application of the already-documented stale-ratchet-after-revert convention (patterns.md:96, :158, :432), not a new insight.
